turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Hey David, I want to go over one change for the product page.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Right now, out-of-stock products disappear from the page.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: The client wants to keep them visible, even when they're out of stock.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Got it. Should customers still be able to add them to the cart?

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: No, the Add to Cart button should be disabled.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay. So we show the product, but they can't purchase it.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Exactly. We also want to show an “Out of Stock” message.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Makes sense. Should users be able to sign up for a notification?

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Yeah, they should be able to get notified when the product is available again.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay, so the product stays visible, Add to Cart is disabled, and users can sign up for a notification.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Great. I'll add the details to the ticket.
